capabilities: Sync tasks two-way between Obsidian and Todoist
Add links in both directions between tasks and notes
Extract text from images with OCR
Extract text and equations from PDFs
disambiguation: Despite the task-focused name, it also performs OCR on images and PDFs, not only task management.
extras: Requires a free Taskbone account; paid plans exist for power users. Detailed documentation is hosted elsewhere, not in the README.
problem: Obsidian cannot read text out of images and PDFs for search, and its tasks do not stay in sync with Todoist.

relations.evidence: Keeps Obsidian and Todoist in sync
Out of the box compatability with the popular Tasks Obsidian plugin

summary: OCR and task-sync toolkit that extracts text and equations from images and PDFs and keeps Obsidian tasks in sync with Todoist.
